## Details

<a id="init_game_state"></a>
### [`init_game_state`](../../../../src/init/state.asm#L6) `$9106`

*routine*

Clears the story and game flags. Sets demo_mode = 1 and opponent_index = 4. Fills the block stores. The start and each restart call it.

- **Called from:** [`start`](init.md#start)
- **Calls:** [`fill_block_stores`](state.md#fill_block_stores)
- **Writes:** [`bout_loser`](../../memory-map.md#bout_loser), [`goblin_active`](../../memory-map.md#goblin_active), [`goblin_drags`](../../memory-map.md#goblin_drags), [`turn_request`](../../memory-map.md#turn_request), [`time_out_active`](../../memory-map.md#time_out_active), [`sprite_mirror_state`](../../memory-map.md#sprite_mirror_state), [`bout_winner`](../../memory-map.md#bout_winner), [`game_started`](../../memory-map.md#game_started), [`setup_active`](../../memory-map.md#setup_active), [`final_stage`](../../memory-map.md#final_stage), [`final_goal_reached`](../../memory-map.md#final_goal_reached), [`two_players`](../../memory-map.md#two_players) and 5 more

<a id="clear_sprites"></a>
### [`clear_sprites`](../../../../src/init/state.asm#L51) `$914F`

*routine*

Clears the sprite positions $02-$12 and switches off all sprites. Clears the VIC sprite registers and sets a black border.

- **Called from:** [`start`](init.md#start)
